obligations.statement: Write all 32 supplied bits to its IDR.
Read returns the independently stored 32-bit IDR value.
Preserve every other register and other peripheral instances.
No startup accesses occur in this scope.
No status polling occurs in this scope.
No allocation or setup occur in this scope.

The public functions are exactly void LL_CRC_Write_IDR(CRC_TypeDef *CRCx, uint32_t InData) and uint32_t LL_CRC_Read_IDR(const CRC_TypeDef *CRCx); the caller supplies a valid accessible instance, so a call reports no error code.
Invalid pointers/inaccessible hardware and CRC polynomial/calculation/configuration are outside this invocation domain.
